source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
When you add this model to your army, pick a keyword from the list below. It gets that keyword and the extra weapon listed for it, both for the rest of the battle:

- **KHORNE**: torrent of burning blood
- **SLAANESH**: scream of despair
- **NURGLE**: phlegm bombardment
- **TZEENTCH**: warp gaze

detail.trigger: select Soul Grinder for the army
detail.duration: until the end of the battle
